sources.title: CIA World Factbook · archived country profile

recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Sovereign country. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
capital: Santiago; note - Valparaiso is the seat of the national legislature
economy: export-driven economy; leading copper producer; though hit by COVID-19, fairly quick rebound from increased liquidity and rapid vaccine rollouts; decreasing poverty but still lingering inequality; public debt rising but still manageable; recent political violence has had negative economic consequences GDP (PPP): $596.556 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: Armed Forces of Chile (Fuerzas Armadas de Chile): Chilean Army (Ejército de Chile), Chilean Navy (Armada de Chile, includes Marine Corps and Maritime Territory and Merchant Marine Directorate or Directemar), Chilean Air Force (Fuerza Aerea de Chile, FACh) (2025) Expenditure: 1.5% of GDP (2024 est.)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
